method: 64 calls emitted before any reply; host sends ret 64..1; RTT is host ret enqueue → guest promise continuation/debug ack → host validated log. No external tool/network work. Static qjs is fresh per session via docker exec -i in one temporary Linux arm64 container; CLI startup included in startupMs; not virtio.
quantiles: p50 is conventional median (average middle two for even n); p90/p99 nearest rank
